legend: kind: hit = a marked moment; note = a single sound; layer = a sustained bed; stream = a repeating pattern (one entry for the pattern, individual entries for the hits where the editor needs them); gap = silence. dur is in frames.

ranges.mood: dark, quiet, held breath: waking in the cell, a PA crackle, first grey light. The score is room tone, a heartbeat, a low drone. Hit at the first frame of bar 5.

the routine of C-Block: bars, shafts of light crossing an empty hall, doors, the ROUTINE board, the watch booth, tally marks, the mess hall. Cuts of 2-3 beats speeding up to 1 beat. A pulse enters at bar 9.
Intake and Records: the reader, the keycard / shim, the ceiling camera and its cone, the ledger and the transfer order. Tense, 1-2 beat cuts, first-person hands allowed.
the alarm: camera snaps, red lamps, lockdown PA, doors, sprint in first person, boots, bars. 8-16 frame cuts, the loudest part of the trailer.
one bar: everything stops. A dark single held image (the cell door, the arrest fade); silence in the score. The CAUGHT card is added by the titles.
calm, 4-8 beat shots: the chapel, stained-glass light pooling on the floor, shafts, candles, the baptismal font lifting. Piano and strings enter.
down the steps and along the tunnel: lantern light on brick, fog, a light at the far end. Slow forward moves, 4-6 beat shots, rising hope.

out into the golden forest: god rays, the path, the clearing, the oak, the crate, a lantern; two figures only as backlit silhouettes from behind and far; the pull-back toward the prison in the haze. The score swells and resolves.
the plate under the title lockup (slow drift over the clearing or the haze), fading to black at the end of bar 50.
